component.name: Starshard 05
component.summary: Retro arcade space shooter with inertia and wraparound combat

description.p: Starshard 05 is a fast retro arcade shooter built around inertia, precise turning, and screen-wrap survival.
Pilot a wireframe ship through escalating asteroid waves, thread between fragments, and keep momentum under control while chasing longer runs and higher scores.

ul.li: Vulkan-rendered arcade action with wraparound arenas
Keyboard, mouse, and touchpad control layouts
Profiles, persistent settings, and run stat tracking

screenshot.caption: Placeholder gameplay scene for the first Flathub-ready package pass

description.p: First Flathub-ready release with installable Linux metadata, sandbox packaging, and packaged shader assets.
